title: The kb MCP server serves a group's own tools, named as extension point mcp_tools, under the group's prefix and refuses one whose name clashes with a shipped tool
goal: kb_mcp.py serves each tool of extensions.mcp_tools, a dict with name, description, inputSchema and call, as <group>_<name> beside the shipped tools; the tool's description starts with the group name; a tools/call runs call with the arguments and returns its text; an exception in call becomes an isError result; a tool whose prefixed name equals a shipped tool's is left out with one stderr line naming it; a missing group name or a load failure leaves the group's tools out with one stderr line naming the point; the shipped tools are served as before

gates.question: How does kb_mcp.py read the extension point mcp_tools, and where are the group's tools served?
options: extensions.mcp_tools is one module:attr or a list of them (each attribute a tool dict or a list), else an entry point; served only on the team's own server, never under --roots or in the kbtools catalog
extensions.mcp_tools is one module:attr only, served on every server

gates.question: What does a load failure or a malformed tool dict leave out, and how does a tool's description and result take the group name?

only the failing spec's tools are left out; description prefixed only when it lacks the group name
